ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/TA444 fake-recruiter ISO/LNK → wscript proxied-DLL execution (AppleJeus/RustBucket precursor)
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's signature 'fake recruiter / fake VC' social-engineering chain where a victim opens a fake job-spec ISO/IMG/ZIP attachment, an embedded LNK or HTA invokes wscript/cscript or rundll32 to side-load a malicious DLL from %APPDATA%/%TEMP%, then beacons to a typosquatted finance/crypto domain. This is the documented TA444 cluster's initial-access→execution→C2 chain behind AppleJeus, SnatchCrypto, and 2023-2024 RustBucket / KandyKorn campaigns.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*.iso*" OR Processes.process="*.img*" OR Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*.vbs*" OR Processes.process="*.js*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.dest 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!=internal AND (All_Traffic.dest IN ("*coinbase-careers*","*crypto-jobs*","*binance-hr*","*kraken-recruit*","*defi-jobs*","*web3-careers*") OR All_Traffic.dest="*.workers.dev" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.000webhostapp.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*ngrok*") by host All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port 
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` 
| rename dest as c2_dest] 
| where lastTime - firstTime < 600 
| table firstTime host user process_name parent_process_name process c2_dest hashes 
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 600;
let RecruiterLures = dynamic(["job","jd","jobdesc","offer","interview","position","compensation","benefit","hr_","recruit","opportunit","role_","resume","cv_"]);
let CryptoLures = dynamic(["coinbase","binance","kraken","crypto","defi","web3","blockchain","nft","wallet","metamask","ledger"]);
let StagingDirs = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\programdata\"]);
let SuspExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","7z.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".iso",".img",".vhd",".lnk",".vbs",".js",".hta",".dll",".ocx")
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any (StagingDirs)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, FolderPath;
let LureFile = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName has_any (RecruiterLures) or FileName has_any (CryptoLures)
    | where FileName endswith ".iso" or FileName endswith ".img" or FileName endswith ".zip"
         or FileName endswith ".lnk" or FileName endswith ".vhd" or FileName endswith ".rar"
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, LureName = FileName, LurePath = FolderPath;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","curl.exe")
        or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CryptoLures)
        or RemoteUrl has_any ("recruit","career","hire","hr.","jobs.")
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".workers.dev"
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".trycloudflare.com"
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".000webhostapp.com"
        or RemoteUrl has "ngrok"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, NetInit = InitiatingProcessFileName;
SuspExec
| join kind=inner LureFile on DeviceId
| where DropTime between (ExecTime - 1h .. ExecTime)
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project DropTime, ExecTime, NetTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LureName, LurePath, ParentImage, ChildImage, ChildCmd, SHA256,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 600;
let CryptoLures = dynamic(["coinbase","binance","kraken","crypto","defi","web3","blockchain","wallet","metamask","ledger"]);
let RecruiterLures = dynamic(["job","jobdesc","offer","interview","recruit","resume","opportunit"]);
let SuspExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("explorer.exe","OUTLOOK.EXE","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe")
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (".iso",".img",".lnk",".vbs",".js",".hta",".dll")
        or CommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\Temp\",@"\Downloads\")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
let Egress = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Palo Alto Networks","Fortinet","Zscaler","Cisco")
    | where RequestURL has_any (CryptoLures)
        or RequestURL has_any ("recruit","career","hr.","jobs.")
        or RequestURL endswith ".workers.dev"
        or RequestURL endswith ".trycloudflare.com"
        or RequestURL has "ngrok"
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, SrcHost = SourceHostName, DstHost = DestinationHostName, RequestURL, RequestClientApplication;
SuspExec
| join kind=inner Egress on $left.Computer == $right.SrcHost
| where NetTime between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project ExecTime, NetTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, RequestURL, DstHost
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Recruiter ISO/LNK to Script Host Proxied Execution
id: e1c5a7d6-9b3a-4f1d-bd58-b1f1bluenoroff
status: experimental
description: Detects Bluenoroff/TA444 fake-recruiter ISO/IMG/ZIP chains where archive/browser/Outlook child wscript/cscript/rundll32 launches a script or DLL from user-writeable staging directories — characteristic of AppleJeus, RustBucket and SnatchCrypto delivery.
author: SOC detection-eng
date: 2026/05/31
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/apt38-details-on-new-north-korean-regime-backed-threat-group
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/applejeus-bluenoroff-targets-cryptocurrency-firms/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_artifact:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.iso'
      - '.img'
      - '.lnk'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.js'
      - '.hta'
      - '.dll'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_artifact and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate vendor installers that ship as ISO and run script-based bootstrappers from %TEMP%
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.g0098
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\7zg.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe) @Image:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE) @CommandLine:(*.iso* OR *.img* OR *.lnk* OR *.vbs* OR *.js* OR *.hta* OR *.dll* OR *\AppData\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\Downloads\* OR *\ProgramData\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|outlook|chrome|msedge|firefox|7zg|7zfm|winrar|7z)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\.iso|\\.img|\\.vhd|\\.lnk|\\.vbs|\\.js|\\.hta|\\.dll|\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Downloads\\\\)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest | regex("(?i)(coinbase|binance|kraken|crypto|defi|web3|wallet|recruit|career|jobs|workers\\.dev|trycloudflare|000webhostapp|ngrok)", field=DomainName)}, field=aid, include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName], function=count())
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: This is the canonical Bluenoroff/TA444 (APT38, Stardust Chollima) initial-access chain documented across AppleJeus (2018-present), SnatchCrypto (2022 KSB), RustBucket (2023, Jamf/Elastic), and KandyKorn (2023, Elastic): fake recruiter / fake VC partner sends an ISO/IMG/ZIP impersonating a crypto exchange role-description, the victim mounts/extracts it, an embedded LNK or VBS spawns wscript/cscript

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff macOS RustBucket/KandyKorn second-stage launchd persistence + signed-binary AppleScript abuse
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's documented macOS persistence pattern in RustBucket (2023) and KandyKorn (2023 attack on a crypto-exchange engineer): a second-stage Rust/ObjC payload drops to ~/Library/, registers a LaunchAgent plist pointing at a hidden binary, and abuses signed Apple binaries (osascript, sqlite3, plutil) to read Keychain / browser data and stage exfil. Couples plist creation with osascript-driven keychain access in a short window — the combination Bluenoroff uniquely uses to survive reboots on macOS finance/crypto engineering hosts.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as plistTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as plist_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/LaunchDaemons/*.plist") AND Filesystem.action=created by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` 
| join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as scriptTime values(Processes.process) as script_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("osascript","sqlite3","security","plutil","curl","defaults") AND (Processes.process="*keychain*" OR Processes.process="*Login.keychain*" OR Processes.process="*Cookies.binarycookies*" OR Processes.process="*Local Storage*" OR Processes.process="*MetaMask*" OR Processes.process="*Exodus*" OR Processes.process="*Electrum*" OR Processes.process="*Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] 
| where scriptTime - plistTime < 1800 AND scriptTime > plistTime 
| join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!=internal AND All_Traffic.app IN ("curl","osascript","swift","node") by host All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port 
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` 
| rename dest as exfil_dest] 
| table plistTime scriptTime host user file_name plist_path writer script_cmd exfil_dest 
| sort - plistTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800;
let WalletKeywords = dynamic(["keychain","login.keychain","metamask","exodus","electrum","phantom","trustwallet","ledger","binarycookies","local storage","cookies.sqlite","history.db","logins.json"]);
let PlistDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceName !startswith "" and InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName !has "Microsoft"
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FolderPath has_any ("/Library/LaunchAgents/","/Library/LaunchDaemons/","/Library/StartupItems/")
    | where FileName endswith ".plist"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("installer","system_installd","softwareupdated","Xcode","brew")
    | project PlistTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              PlistPath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
              Writer = InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, WriterSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let SecretAccess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("osascript","sqlite3","security","plutil","defaults","curl","base64")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (WalletKeywords)
        or ProcessCommandLine has "do shell script"
        or ProcessCommandLine has "with administrator privileges"
        or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"security\s+(find-generic-password|find-internet-password|dump-keychain)"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SecretTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, AccountName,
              SecretTool = FileName, SecretCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SecretParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("curl","osascript","swift","node","python3","sh","bash","zsh")
        or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has "/private/tmp/"
        or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has "/Users/Shared/"
        or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has "/Library/"
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, ExfilProc = InitiatingProcessFileName;
PlistDrop
| join kind=inner SecretAccess on DeviceId
| where SecretTime between (PlistTime .. PlistTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (PlistTime .. PlistTime + 2 * WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project PlistTime, SecretTime, ExfilTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          PlistPath, Writer, WriterCmd, WriterSHA256,
          SecretTool, SecretCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by PlistTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800;
let WalletKeywords = dynamic(["keychain","login.keychain","metamask","exodus","electrum","phantom","binarycookies","cookies.sqlite","logins.json"]);
let PlistDrop = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any ("/Library/LaunchAgents/","/Library/LaunchDaemons/")
    | where TargetFilePath endswith ".plist"
    | where ActingProcessName !in~ ("installer","softwareupdated","brew")
    | project PlistTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetFilePath, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let SecretAccess = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName in~ ("osascript","sqlite3","security","plutil","defaults","curl")
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (WalletKeywords)
        or ActingProcessCommandLine has "do shell script"
        or ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"security\s+(find-generic-password|find-internet-password|dump-keychain)"
    | project SecretTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
PlistDrop
| join kind=inner SecretAccess on DvcHostname
| where SecretTime between (PlistTime .. PlistTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project PlistTime, SecretTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          TargetFilePath, PlistWriter = ActingProcessName, PlistCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          SecretTool = ActingProcessName1, SecretCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine1
| order by PlistTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:linux.auditd OR source:macos.osquery) (@process.name:(osascript OR sqlite3 OR security OR plutil) AND @process.command_line:(*keychain* OR *Login.keychain* OR *MetaMask* OR *Exodus* OR *Electrum* OR *binarycookies* OR *"do shell script"* OR *"find-generic-password"* OR *"dump-keychain"*)) OR (@auditd.type:PATH AND @file.path:(*/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist OR */Library/LaunchDaemons/*.plist)) -@process.executable.path:(/usr/sbin/installer OR /System/Library/* OR /usr/local/Homebrew/*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 event_platform=Mac
| ImageFileName=/\/(osascript|sqlite3|security|plutil|defaults|curl|base64)$/i
| regex("(?i)(keychain|login\\.keychain|metamask|exodus|electrum|phantom|binarycookies|cookies\\.sqlite|logins\\.json|do shell script|with administrator privileges|find-generic-password|dump-keychain)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten event_platform=Mac | regex("(?i)/Library/(LaunchAgents|LaunchDaemons|StartupItems)/.+\\.plist$", field=TargetFileName) | NOT ContextImageFileName=/\/(installer|softwareupdated|system_installd|brew)$/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName])

| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Bluenoroff/TA444 is one of the very few state actors with sustained, public macOS tradecraft against crypto/finance engineers — Jamf, Elastic, and SentinelOne all attributed RustBucket (May 2023) and KandyKorn (Nov 2023) to this DPRK cluster. The signature behaviour is: drop a stage-2 Rust/ObjC binary, register a LaunchAgent plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ pointing at a hidden binary in ~/Library
